# Coasely

> Coasely (coasely.com) is a free, bilingual (Polish/English) business-idea calculator. In 7 steps it checks whether a small business idea makes sense: local competition, costs, break-even point, net profit after Polish taxes and social security (ZUS), a 12-month forecast and a stress test. No sign-up; data stays in the browser.

Creator: Maja Kosmowska (Warsaw, Poland), finalist of the Polish National Economics Olympiad and the Entrepreneurship Olympiad.

## The 7 steps
1. Idea – business type, location, business model
2. Market – how many similar businesses are registered nearby (GUS REGON, OpenStreetMap), population (GUS BDL)
3. Costs – fixed and variable costs, staff, rent
4. Financing – own capital, loan, depreciation
5. Profitability – break-even point, contribution margin, net profit after tax and ZUS (2026 rules)
6. Forecast – 12 months with ramp-up and seasonality
7. Test – pessimistic scenarios and sensitivity

## Who it is for
Students, first-time founders, teachers of entrepreneurship classes, and anyone who wants to check a small business idea (café, hair salon, online course, shop) before investing.

## Pages
- https://coasely.com/ – calculator (English)
- https://coasely.com/pl/ – calculator (Polish)
- https://coasely.com/kalkulator-progu-rentownosci/ – break-even calculator explainer (Polish)
- https://coasely.com/gdzie-zaczac-biznes-ranking/ – 2026 market-gap ranking of 208 Polish towns (GUS REGON data, CSV download)
- https://coasely.com/dla-nauczycieli/ – free 45-minute lesson plan and printable worksheet for teachers (PDF, Polish)
- https://coasely.com/czy-oplaca-sie/ – Is it profitable? Worked break-even examples by industry (Polish): café, kebab shop, hair salon, online course
- https://coasely.com/czy-oplaca-sie-otworzyc-kawiarnie/ – Is opening a café profitable? Worked example (Polish)
- https://coasely.com/czy-oplaca-sie-otworzyc-kebab/ – Is opening a kebab shop profitable? (Polish)
- https://coasely.com/czy-oplaca-sie-otworzyc-salon-fryzjerski/ – Is opening a hair salon profitable? (Polish)
- https://coasely.com/czy-oplaca-sie-sprzedawac-kurs-online/ – Is selling an online course profitable? (Polish)

Results are estimates, not tax or investment advice.
